pocket.name: The flexible C-terminal ectodomain/profusion segment of gD, narrowed...
pocket.why_this_rank: C4 is demonstrably antibody-bindable and therefore not excluded, but native glycan/membrane context is missing and its strongly acidic, nonaromatic surface is the weakest chemistry match to HAB194. Same-site nonneutralization weakens only the advocate's claimed consequence, not the epitope possibility.
pocket.rests_on: The native glycosylated tail remains accessible to HAB194 and a subset of its CDRs can accommodate the acidic linear peptide.
pocket.what_it_is: The flexible C-terminal ectodomain/profusion segment of gD, narrowed to the exposed 262–272 linear antigenic region that links the folded receptor-binding core to the membrane-proximal continuation and is displaced during receptor-triggering.
pocket.why_one_candidate: not pooled with anything: no other patch is both within 12 A (half centroid distance, half contact-graph hops) and coverable by one paratope of this antibody's reach, 17.7 A

note: `confidence` on the pocket is over pockets and sums to about 1 across them. Inside an interface it is per residue in [0, 1] and sums to nothing. No residue is cut at a threshold: the whole vector is the answer.

paratope.heavy_light_split: Approximately 65:35 heavy:light along the extended peptide. L1/L3 take the glycan-adjacent C:262–264 edge, both chains converge over C:265–268, and H3/H2 cover the Leu268–Asp272 half.

pooling_provenance.note: counts only, describing how the organizer grouped the phase-1 patches. The organizer's own candidate residue list is deliberately absent: the answer is the advocate's footprint, in `residues` and in `antibodies[].interfaces[]`.

advocate.weakest_point: The strongest available functional evidence cuts against the premise: known monoclonals to the same 262–272 linear epitope bind but do not neutralize. In addition, the native C:262 N-glycan and membrane-proximal context are absent from the supplied isolated structure, so high calculated exposure may overstate virion accessibility.
advocate.note: the advocate reports claim/source/date/bearing and is not asked whether a source is about this binder

judge.note: Tier A -- a source about this binder itself -- is the judge's adjudication, in assessment[].support[]. It exists nowhere in the advocate's own answer.
